content.comment_body: It's not possible to install the setup application downloaded from [company_name] [product_name] demo software. When opening the Setup file, installation fails and seems to be blocked by admin controls from [company_name]. I'm logged in with admin privileges; all other apps install correctly except this demo program. This is a brand new M1 MacBook running the latest Big Sur OS. See the link where I downloaded the software: [url]

Please ensure your operating system is compatible. [product_name] V8.3 works with: Mac OS X 10.8 Mountain Lion, 10.9 Mavericks, 10.10 Yosemite, 10.11 El Capitan, 10.12 Sierra, 10.13 High Sierra, and 10.14 Mojave. [product_name] V8.2 supports: Mac OS X 10.7 Lion, 10.8 Mountain Lion, 10.9 Mavericks, 10.10 Yosemite, and 10.11 El Capitan.
The actual [product_name] demo currently available is version 8.2, not 8.3.
Is there any way to install [product_name] 8.3 on a Mac with Intel processor and running macOS Big Sur 11.1?
Here's a post from the German part of the forum.
Sorry, I meant macOS Big Sur 11.1 on a MacBook Pro with Intel processor.
Did you read my answer above your last post?
I read your message but I'm not sure about the next step—after downloading setup.zip, should I unzip it? What do I need to confirm for installation?

I think you haven't checked the translated information. I don't use Mac myself, but I'm trying to help by referencing similar forum posts. A user in the German forum suggests: download the app 'unarchiver' and use 'open with' via right-click. The 'unarchiver' app will then appear, and after an error message, you should check Settings → Security → General. The setup.zip software should be shown there; just confirm it. Doing this allowed [product_name] 8.3 including LWE to run on MacOS Big Sur 11.2.3.
I have the same issue: MacOS Big Sur won't allow installation. Does anyone have advice?
Did you see my post above yours? Have you tried the suggested steps?

This worked for me (MacBook Pro 2020, Intel, macOS Monterey): Hello [user_name], For me, the process was: download the 'unarchiver' app, select 'open with' using the right mouse button, then the 'unarchiver' app appears. You’ll get an error message, but check under Settings → Security → General and confirm the setup.zip software. After confirming, [product_name] 8.3 and LWE worked on macOS Big Sur 11.2.3. Thanks for the tip. Greetings, [user_name]
This method worked for me on macOS Big Sur (MacBook Air, early 2014). Quite unexpected but effective.

I’m having the same problem with OS X 13.3 (Ventura) on an M1 Apple Mac and Amazon Coretta Java VM installed. I’ve downloaded the [product_name] v8.3 demo software, but double-clicking Setup gives an error: “The application Setup can't be opened.” The Security & Privacy pane in System Settings shows no violation errors. What’s the latest way to resolve this and get it running?

analysis.insight_summary: The primary issue discussed is users not being able to install the [product_name] demo software on newer MacBooks, especially those using MacOS Big Sur (11.x) and Apple M1 or Intel chips. Despite having admin access and successful installations for other apps, this software fails to install—mainly because its compatibility stops at MacOS Mojave. The installation steps for the package are unclear, and users seek specific guidance for later MacOS versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the demo software to work seamlessly on the latest MacBook models with updated MacOS versions, such as Big Sur 11.x. They also want detailed, straightforward instructions for the setup and installation process.
